core_obligations: Write K = R lim tau_{>=-n}K using the is-limit-dimension lemma with d = 0 (proof lines 9774-9776).

Insert the short exact sequence for H^q(U,K) and identify H^q(U, tau_{>=-n}K) = H^0(U, H^q(tau_{>=-n}K)) via the spectral sequence of Example spectral-sequence, which converges because tau_{>=-n}K is bounded below (proof lines 9777-9786).
For n > -q the systems on both sides are eventually constant with values H^0(U, H^{q-1}(K)) and H^0(U, H^q(K)); conclude H^q(U,K) = H^0(U, H^q(K)) for U  in  B (proof lines 9787-9792).

Use the Milnor sequence and the convergent spectral sequence.
